product.olivetti-m250.summary: 1989 8 MHz 80286 desktop with integrated Paradise VGA-compatible video and 1 MB standard memory.
product.olivetti-m250.history: The April 1989 M250 brochure positions this 8 MHz, zero-wait-state 80286 as a lower-professional system. It specifies 1 MB memory, integrated 1.44 MB 3.5-inch floppy, 20/40 MB disks, optional 40 MB streaming tape, VGA-compatible graphics, three 8/16-bit XT/AT slots and integrated mouse/video.
product.olivetti-m250.warning: PARTIAL EMULATION: the M250 cold-starts with local firmware and the 2026-09-03 test showed a software reset without Keyboard Error 6 with a newly created NVR. The reset still has to be repeated with the earlier NVR, and POST, Setup and System Test, the RTC and the hard disk remain to be checked. The on-board disk interface is IDE and is emulated with the generic IDE controller; jumpers P6 and P8 are not modelled.
product.olivetti-m250.creation.model: Documented April 1989 baseline: 8 MHz 80286, 1 MB, integrated VGA-compatible video and 1.44 MB 3.5-inch floppy
product.olivetti-m250.creation.note: The optional hard disk is one of the Conner drives in Olivetti's table, on the on-board IDE interface; choose the same type in Setup. Jumper P6 (20 or 40 MB) is not modelled.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.market: Lower-professional market, 1989. The manufacturer brochure names MS-DOS and MS OS/2 compatibility.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.commerci: The brochure documents 8 MHz, 1 MB, a 3.5-inch floppy drive, VGA-compatible graphics and a 16-bit AT bus. The service guide and the BIOS list the Conner drives in Setup: CP3022 20 MB, CP346 and CP3142 40 MB, and CP3106 100 MB.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.physical: Manufacturer brochure: base unit 412 × 109 × 393 mm, 9 kg; keyboard 2 kg. It also lists 340 × 315 × 300 mm / 6 kg monochrome and 370 × 360 × 380 mm / 16 kg colour monitors.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.cpu: Intel 80286 at 8 MHz with zero wait states, as stated by the 1989 product brochure.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.memory: 1 MB is the brochure baseline and 2 MB is documented by the service material as the M250 limit. The catalogue offers both; only the 1 MB profile has the recorded isolated startup/reset observation.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.video: Integrated Paradise PVGA1A/OVC, presented commercially as VGA-compatible graphics. The local firmware set has a separate PERC 1.06 video image.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.storage: The board carries an AT disk interface at 1F0h-1F7h and IRQ 14. Olivetti calls it the AT/RLL adapter and the board manual identifies it as an IDE interface. Setup types in BIOS 1.03: 1, CP346 40 MB (805/4/26); 2, CP3106 100 MB (776/8/33); 3, CP3142 40 MB (635/4/33); 4, CP3022 20 MB (615/4/17). The service guide gives 766 cylinders for type 2, but the BIOS table has 776. P6 is set to 1-2 for the 40 MB drives and to 2-3 for the CP3022 or no disk; the BIOS does not read it to detect the disk, which it takes from CMOS. Creation offers the four types.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.jumpers: P1/P2 choose 512 KB, 1 MB or 2 MB of on-board DRAM; P6 the disk capacity and interleave, and P8 connects the battery. BluMach does not model them: memory is chosen when the machine is created and P6 changes nothing on the emulated IDE interface.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.firmware: Observed local sets are PERB 1.03 system BIOS and PERC 1.06 PVGA1A video BIOS. Their bytes are local-only and are not included in BluMach.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.verified: Local isolated cold initialization at 8 MHz/1 MB; user-observed software reset without Keyboard Error 6 on 2026-09-03 with newly-created NVR. Historical records also report M250 POST, Setup and System Test boot.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.limitati: The reset still has to be repeated with the earlier NVR, and POST, Setup and System Test checked again. The RTC, installing an operating system and the hard disk with Olivetti's types remain open. The M250 E needs its own full validation.
product.olivetti-m250.technical.brochure: Olivetti M250 commercial brochure, 1989 (access-restricted preservation listing)
product.olivetti-m250.technical.service_: Olivetti Pocket Service Guide, M250/M250 E technical sections
product.olivetti-m250.technical.collecti: ISER preservation inventory for an M250 XP1530 unit (secondary evidence)
product.olivetti-m250.creation.storage.n: No hard disk: one 1.44 MB floppy drive
